flags.reason: The guide gives no avoidWhen guidance; left empty rather than guessed.

The guide and most of its evidence were checked on 21 October on 0.1.78-c7d3348 and not re-checked on the installed build, dbe0e02, which changed PlanComparisonCard for #360 (plan names centred over their columns, names that end in … on one line, labels and values that wrap, rows of at least 46 px, a table with rows, column headers and cells, a cross named “Not included”, infoLabel and notIncludedLabel). This entry follows the installed package and leaves out the guide sentences dbe0e02 contradicts (listed in its notes). The guide also doesn't say which surface hosts the card: its plan names are white with no panel behind them, every example sits on the docs' dark frame, and on a light Coin Screen the names don't show, so the entry's examples carry no host. Re-extract once #360 is fixed and the guide is re-checked and published. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch10, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Upgrading from the user's plan, the guide's two-plan comparison: “Your plan” first, then the upgrade by its product name, gold as the recommended plan (brand). false marks what “Your plan” doesn't include, and showInfo adds hint icons to the features that need explaining.
examples.jsx:
<PlanComparisonCard
  columns={[{ label: 'Your plan' }, { label: 'JioFinance+', brand: true }]}
  rows={[
    { label: 'JioPoints multiplier', values: ['1x', '1.25x'] },
    { label: 'Cashback', showInfo: true, values: [false, '₹5,000'] },
    { label: 'Bonus JioGold', showInfo: true, values: [false, '1%'] },
  ]}
/>

from.quote: The current plan first, the upgrade by its product name.

props.name: columns
props.description: Left out, the card shows two sample plans: “Your plan”, and “JioFinance+” with brand. Declared: Plan column headers (excludes the leading label column). The order here maps 1:1 to each row's `values` array.

props.name: rows
props.description: Left out, the card shows four sample feature rows. Declared: Feature rows compared across the plan columns.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the table body; the plan names still come from columns. The card gives the slot no panel, border or padding. Declared: Slot that replaces the default comparison table (Figma `Slot`). When omitted, the table is built from `columns` + `rows`. Header still renders from `columns`. `modes` are cascaded into slot children.

props.name: infoLabel
props.description: Spoken prefix for each info icon, followed by the row label. Defaults to `"More information about"`. Default "More information about", from the component source.

props.name: notIncludedLabel
props.description: Spoken name for a `false` cell (the muted cross). Defaults to `"Not included"`. Default "Not included", from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Used for the card's tokens and cascaded to slot children and element cells; a child's own modes win. Declared: Design token modes for theming (e.g. `{ "Color Mode": "Light" }`).

props.name: style
props.description: Applied to the root after its own { gap: 16, width: '100%' }. Declared: Override the outer container style.

props.name: PlanComparisonColumn.label
props.description: A field of each columns item: the plan's name, one header per plan.

props.name: PlanComparisonColumn.brand
props.description: A field of each columns item: true turns that plan's name gold. Any number of columns can be given, and any number branded.

props.name: PlanComparisonRow.label
props.description: A field of each rows item: the feature's label.

props.name: PlanComparisonRow.values
props.description: A field of each rows item: values[i] fills plan column i. A string or number shows as white text (12 px, weight 500, centred); false as a grey cross (ic_close, 16 px); null, undefined or true leave the cell empty; a React element is rendered as it is and given the card's modes. A short array leaves empty cells; extra values are ignored.

props.name: PlanComparisonRow.showInfo
props.description: A field of each rows item: adds a white 16 px info icon (ic_info) after the label.

props.name: PlanComparisonRow.onInfoPress
props.description: A field of each rows item: implies showInfo and wraps the icon in a Pressable, a button named “More information about” and the label, with hitSlop 8 (about 32 × 32 on the web); Enter and Space work.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection PlanComparisonCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Slot that replaces the default comparison table (Figma `Slot`). When omitted, the table is built from `columns` + `rows`. Header still renders from `columns`. `modes` are cascaded into slot children.

gaps.text: Figma draws a row line under rows 1 and 2 only; the package puts one under every row but the last.
